text:
maya: thinking out loud — can we add a compact inspector 'quick pin' action on per-route and per-model cards? idea: single-click pins that appear in a slim right rail for compare/telemetry peek.
alex: love the UX idea. would save clicks when people want to pin a route + model combo for short-term debugging.
sam: this will affect saved_query & route routing APIs. do we mean ephemeral pins (session-scoped) or persisted saved queries?
maya: ephemeral by default, with an opt-in to persist -> becomes a saved_query. want pin to carry routing hint (e.g., region preference + fallback variant) and telemetry sampling flag.
joe: API thoughts: add a lightweight endpoint POST /inspector/pins that accepts {scope, target_id, model_id?, ephemeral:true, routing_hint?:"eu-prefer"}. persist flow would call existing /saved_queries. keep it separate to avoid bloating saved_query schema.
alex: UI: pin icon on card, ctrl-click to persist. pinned items show small telemetry peek (cost token estimate + 95th latency sample). can we reuse existing telemetry snippets?
sam: telemetry backend: for ephemeral pins we should surface cached recent metrics (last 1k requests) instead of running a fresh expensive query. add query param ?cached=true to telemetry API.
maya: and we need quota clarity: ephemeral pins should be free to create, but fetching telemetry peek counts against sample-query budget. add visible quota badge on pin panel.
joe: agree. also add a routed fallback note — if user's pinned model variant isn't available, pin should have a fallback tooltip and a compact 'swap to compatible' button that triggers a transparent route change.
alex: small UI sketch: right rail with 6 slots, each slot shows: route name, model tag, cpu/gpu icon, small sparkline, cost badge. hover reveals persist/save, share link, remove.
console-bot: noted: design doc requested — /docs/inspector-quickpin.md created draft at /design/inspector-quickpin (internal).
maya: integration checklist: 1) pin API contract 2) telemetry cached endpoint 3) quota badge hook 4) fallback routing UX 5) saved_query conversion path 6) tests + rollout gate.
sam: for rollout, toggle behind feature-flag inspector_quickpin. telemetry sampling default off for pinned items until user clicks 'peek' to avoid accidental cost.
joe: security: ensure ephemeral pins can't leak org-scoped sensitive query params. strip headers and redact route secrets.
alex: final Q: sharing a pinned slot — should link encode ephemeral state? I think shared links should deep-link to console and reconstruct pin client-side from server state if persisted; otherwise include a transient token valid for 10m.
maya: yep — transient token pattern for ephemeral-share, persisted links for saved queries.
sam: I'll prototype the API and telemetry changes. assigning to @sam for API + backend, @alex for UI mockups.
maya: thanks all — small follow-up meeting tomorrow 10am to review a first mock. :thumbsup:
